author: pgaudet
body:
Dear all, 

The proposal has been made to obsolete  
- GO:0019284 L-methionine salvage from S-adenosylmethionine and replace with parent  GO:0033353 S-adenosylmethionine cycle
- GO:0019509 L-methionine salvage from methylthioadenosine and replace with  parent GO:0071267 L-methionine salvage 
as well as 
- GO:0019283 L-methionine biosynthetic process from L-homoserine via O-phospho-L-homoserine and cystathionine
- GO:0019280 L-methionine biosynthetic process from L-homoserine via O-acetyl-L-homoserine
- GO:0019279 L-methionine biosynthetic process from L-homoserine via cystathionine
- GO:0019281 | L-methionine biosynthetic process from homoserine via O-succinyl-L-homoserine and cystathionine

& replace by parent [L-methionine biosynthetic process](http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/GO_0071265). 
see https://github.com/geneontology/go-ontology/issues/31525


There are 61 annotations, including 1 extension to these terms, see https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1uBc36q7KyPwVWDQl6J52YIHvReskp4oBy-AQpZN6A6U/edit?gid=0#gid=0

MTBBASE	1
AspGD	1
PomBase	1
EcoCyc	6
SGD	23
CACAO	2
GeneDB	8
Reactome	4
TAIR	6
UniProt	8

These terms are not in any subsets. MetaCyc mappings have been migrated to the parent. 


There are 15 HAMAP
10 InterPro
18 UniRule


Annotations are here: https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1uBc36q7KyPwVWDQl6J52YIHvReskp4oBy-AQpZN6A6U/edit?gid=0#gid=0

author: pgaudet
body:
Hi @edwong57 @amandamackie 

After further looking into the terms here https://github.com/geneontology/go-ontology/issues/31525#issuecomment-3992744905
@sjm41 proposes to obsolete GO:0019284 L-methionine salvage from S-adenosylmethionine with no replacement, because not all annotations can be moved to the parent term. 

> Looking at the 3 EXP annotations to 'L-methionine salvage from S-adenosylmethionine':

> Yeast SAM4 from PMID:14189892 by SGD - purifies and characterises the SAM4 enzyme, which is the "transfer of the methyl group of S-adenosyl-methionine to homocysteine, resulting in the products, methionine and S-adenosylhomocysteine". This seems to describe the 'S-adenosylmethionine cycle' (and SAM4 is already annotated to that term from the same paper!).

> E.coli Mtn from PMID:9524204 by EcoCyc - this paper solely describes the cloning and enzymatic characterization. No BP is stated or investigated, though "salvage" is given as a keyword. So, either remove this BP or annotate to parent 'L-methionine salvage'

> E.coli LuxS from PMID:11489131 by EcoCyc - this paper shows that "LuxS is the AI-2 synthase and that AI-2 is produced from S-adenosylmethionine in three enzymatic steps. The substrate for LuxS is S-ribosylhomocysteine, which is cleaved to form two products, one of which is homocysteine, and the other is AI-2" The 'AI-2' indicates 'autoinducer 2'. This represents a variant of the 'L-methionine cycle' (corresponding to MetaCyc:PWY-6151, a narrowMatch xref on that GO term).

Can you please review your annotations? 
Thanks, Pascale
